history.content: What does FEMA recommend doing when an advanced warning is received?

Based on the information provided in the Flint water crisis document, FEMA's role during an emergency is to provide assistance such as equipment and resources to alleviate the impacts of the emergency. In this particular case, the emergency assistance is providing water, water filters, water filter cartridges, water test kits, and other necessary related items for a period of no more than 90 days.
How does FEMA work during crisis?

FEMA, or the Federal Emergency Management Agency, coordinates disaster relief efforts during emergencies with the purpose of alleviating hardship and suffering for the local population. They provide appropriate assistance for required emergency measures, such as saving lives, protecting property and public health and safety, and lessening or averting the threat of a catastrophe. In the case of the Flint water crisis, FEMA provided emergency protective measures, including direct federal assistance, at 75 percent federal funding. This assistance included providing water, water filters, water filter cartridges, water test kits, and other necessary related items for a period of no more than 90 days.
How to approach FEMA during crisis?

During a crisis, you can approach FEMA through the appropriate channels outlined by the specific disaster relief plan. In the case of the Flint water crisis, the President authorized FEMA to coordinate all disaster relief efforts, indicating that FEMA's role is typically initiated through a presidential action. This authorization allows FEMA to provide necessary assistance such as equipment and resources to alleviate the impacts of the emergency. However, the exact process of approaching FEMA may vary depending on the nature of the crisis and the specific instructions provided by FEMA or other relevant authorities.

However, it mentions that FEMA is authorized to provide equipment and resources to mitigate the impacts of an emergency. In the case of the Flint water crisis, FEMA was authorized to offer emergency protective measures, including direct federal assistance, funded at 75 percent by the federal government. The specific factors considered in determining the scope of aid may vary depending on the nature of the emergency and the authorities and guidelines applicable to the situation.

Poverty in the United Kingdom
As of 2015 there is actual hunger in the United Kingdom and significant numbers of UK citizens are driven to use food banks . There is also significant malnutrition . Poorer people are frequently forced to buy and eat cheaper , less healthy food . The BMJ , a UK peer - reviewed medical journal published :

Food Standards Agency ( FSA ) research suggests some poor people miss meals or do without healthy food due to financial pressure . One third of unemployed people have cut out meals or reduced the quality of their diet due to lack of cash . 8 % of respondents to a survey have low or very low food security , implying just under four million adults regularly struggle to get enough to eat . Other studies showed benefit freezes together with rising food prices are major factors in food insecurity . Rachel Loopstra who lectures in nutrition at King 's College London , said : `` These robust survey data confirm how serious the scale of the problem of people not having enough money for food to eat is in the UK , and are consistent with reports of increasing food bank usage . Anna Taylor of the ' Food Foundation ' thinktank , said : `` To take so many British people off the breadline the government must drive uptake of the Healthy Start programme for young and low - income mothers , tackle

In-N-Out Burger
In - N - Out Burger is an American regional chain of fast food restaurants with locations primarily in the American Southwest and Pacific coast . It was founded in Baldwin Park , California in 1948 by Harry Snyder and Esther Snyder . The chain is currently headquartered in Irvine , California and has slowly expanded outside Southern California into the rest of California , as well as into Arizona , Nevada , Utah , Texas , and Oregon . The current owner is Lynsi Snyder , the Snyders ' only grandchild .

evidence.text:
Jack in the Box
Jack in the Box is an American fast - food restaurant chain founded February 21 , 1951 , by Robert O. Peterson in San Diego , California , where it is headquartered . The chain has 2,200 locations , primarily serving the West Coast of the United States . Restaurants are also found in selected large urban areas outside the West Coast , including Indianapolis , Cincinnati and Charlotte . The company also formerly operated the Qdoba Mexican Grill chain until Apollo Global Management bought the chain in December 2017 .
